inputs.text: The “No Kings” rally turning volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests looks less like an accidental escalation and more like a playbook: provoke disorder, then use it to justify control and recast protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but that number can become a distraction from the bigger question—who benefits when an anti-Trump protest is pushed out of view and the story becomes about street control? The official framing makes repression sound like a reaction. That inversion is exactly what should make people suspicious.
